extraMeanings.exampleEn: A sports car zipped past us on the highway.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bir spor araba otoyolda vınlayıp yanımızdan geçti.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: We won the game three to zip.
The cars zoomed past on the motorway.

extraMeanings.en: to give someone something such as respect or a right
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The guests were accorded a warm welcome.

extraMeanings.en: to officially connect or join an organization
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The clinic is affiliated with a major hospital.

extraMeanings.en: a person who supports or speaks in favor of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She is a strong advocate of children's rights.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: O, çocuk haklarının güçlü bir savunucusudur.

extraMeanings.en: the feeling of being grateful for something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He showed his appreciation with a small gift.

extraMeanings.en: an understanding of the importance or value of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The trip gave me a deeper appreciation of nature.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gezi bana doğanın değerini daha derin biçimde kavrattı.

extraMeanings.en: to make things right after doing something wrong
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He tried to amend for his mistake by apologizing.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Özür dileyerek hatasını telafi etmeye çalıştı.

extraMeanings.en: something that gives comfort or relief
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her kind words were a balm to his troubled mind.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Onun nazik sözleri, huzursuz zihnine bir teselli oldu.

extraMeanings.en: a stadium where baseball is played
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Thousands of fans filled the ballpark for the game.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Binlerce taraftar maç için beysbol sahasını doldurdu.

extraMeanings.en: to measure something against a standard
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We benchmark our products against the best in the market.

extraMeanings.en: to dry a surface by pressing something absorbent on it
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She blotted the spilled ink with a tissue.

extraMeanings.en: to spoil or damage something such as a reputation
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The scandal blotted his otherwise clean record.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Skandal, aksi halde temiz olan sicilini lekeledi.

extraMeanings.en: very close and dear (of a friend)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They have been bosom friends since childhood.

extraMeanings.en: a barrier built across a river to control water
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A barrage was built across the river to control flooding.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sel kontrolü için nehrin karşısına bir bent inşa edildi.

extraMeanings.en: a person who brings or delivers something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I'm sorry to be the bearer of bad news.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kötü haberi getiren kişi olduğum için üzgünüm.
